info.description:
Complete Postman collection for Cisco IOS-XE 17.18.1 RESTCONF APIs.

**Auto-generated** from 747 OpenAPI 3.0 specs covering:
- 34,694 RESTCONF endpoints
- 58,001 operations (GET/PUT/POST/PATCH/DELETE)
- 848 YANG modules across 9 categories (v1 + v2 deep-path)

1. Import the companion environment: `IOS-XE-RESTCONF.postman_environment.json`
2. Set your device IP, username, and password in the environment
3. Disable SSL certificate verification (Settings → General → SSL)

**Authentication:** Uses Basic Auth from environment variables.

**Source:** https://github.com/jeremycohoe/cisco-ios-xe-openapi-swagger
